description: Claim a photo the service kept elsewhere — as a drawing, a reference, or a building it read as a different one — as a view of this building to design from. Returns the `view_id` it becomes; the reference it had been is removed. Offered only when upload_photo answered `can_use_as_view: true`; otherwise the call is refused.

building_id.description: Building id the photo was uploaded to

name: use_photo_as_view
title: Use the photo as a view after all
